Vivek — thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:
1) Final Acme signer: Mark Delaney (CEO) — mark.delaney@acmehealth.com. He prefers to sign electronically via DocuSign.
2) No in-person notarization required for this agreement. We are fine with a standard e-sign flow.
3) Procurement requests a visible PO number field on the order form. Please add a required text field labeled "PO Number (Acme)".

I attached our signature authority matrix — acme_signature_authority_matrix.pdf — which lists Mark and our VP Procurement (email above) as authorized.

We'll accept the sequential flow you proposed, but can parallelize counsel countersign if that speeds it up. If you can provision an envelope with the PO field and placeholder for witness, we'll review and sign.

Regards,
